ns2:section.sectionText: This is an applied course examining the practice of qualitative field methods, with an emphasis on the study of knowledge intensive contexts. Students will approach this subject by: 1) reviewing exemplars of grounded qualitative inquiry, 2) surveying methods texts, and 3) gaining their own experiences in the field. Enrolled students should come prepared with an idea of a qualitative field project they would like to perform throughout the semester.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Communication department.
